Welcome to your Stakeholders Oversight Committee Meeting
We welcome your interest and involvement in the City’s legislative process. This agenda includes information about topics coming before the Stakeholders Oversight Committee and the action recommended by city staff. You can read about each topic in the staff reports, which are available on the city’s website and in the Office of the City Clerk.
Reasonable Accommodations
Individuals with disabilities may request an agenda packet in appropriate alternative formats as required by the Americans with Disability Act of 1990. Reasonable accommodations and auxiliary aids will be provided to effectively allow participation in the meeting. In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance for the meeting, please contact the City Clerk’s Office at (626) 960-4011 ext. 466 or squinones@baldwinpark.com. within 24 hours prior to the meeting so the City can make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility.
Public Comments
The public is encouraged to address the City Council or any of its Agencies listed on this agenda on any matter posted on the agenda or on any other matter within its jurisdiction. In accordance with Chapter 39 of the Baldwin Park Municipal Code, Speakers must address the Council as a whole and refrain from making impertinent, slanderous, or profane remarks or disrupt the peace of the meeting. Speaker cards are available at the podium and by request with the City Clerk.
Public Communication
There is a three-minute speaking time limit. This is the time set aside to address the City Council. Please notify the City Clerk if you require the services of an interpreter. No Action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The legislative body or its staff may: 1) Briefly respond to statements made or questions asked by persons; or 2) Direct staff to investigate and/or schedule matters for consideration at a future meeting. [Government Code §54954.2] If you wish to comment on agenda items and are unable to physically appear in person, please email your name, place of residence, item number or topic and a phone number where you will be available between the hours of 7:00 PM during City Council Meetings to comments@baldwinpark.com.
CALL TO ORDER

PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS
NEW BUSINESS
1.
Measure BP- Investment Opportunity Categories- Formulation and Prioritization - Continued from 10/10/2023 Meeting It is recommended that the Members of the Measure BP Stakeholders Oversight Committee adopt a categorization and prioritization framework for Measure BP project proposals that the SOC will utilize in advancing its recommendations to the City Council. The CEO is herein presenting a draft framework for the SOC's discussion and consideration.
STAFF REPORT
2.
Sports Complex Project- Conceptual Visioning Process - Continued from 10/10/2023 Chair Lara (and Councilmember Damian) provided testimony to the Baldwin Park Unified School District Board of Education at its meeting of October 24, 2023, in support of dedicating closed school sites for sports facilities and open space.
Chief Executive Officer recommends that the SOC hold a discussion on strategies to more effectively pursue the partnership with BPUSD for open space and sports facilities.
STAFF REPORT
3.
Reference Facility Site Tours SOC and Staff conducted a tour on Saturday, October 28, 2023, of the following facilities:
1.
West Covina Sportsplex, City of West Covina
2.
Chino Hills Community Park, City of Chino Hills
3.
Upland Scheu Family YMCA, City of Upland Chief Executive Officer recommends that the SOC and Staff hold a debrief summary discussion regarding the highlights of the Tour.
Chief Executive Officer further recommends that the SOC approve the following reference sites for Tour No. 2, to be conducted on Saturday November 18, 2023:
1.
Glendale Sports Park, City of Glendale
2.
South Gate Sports Park, City of South Gate
3.
La Puente Sports Complex, City of La Puente
4.
SOC Community Engagement Meetings The following two (2) community meetings have been held by the SOC:
a)
Monday October 16, 2023, at 6pm, at the ARC Center
b)
Tuesday, October 17, 2023, at 6pm, at Barnes Park.
Attached are the summary notes of the comments presented by the public during the community meetings.
Chief Executive Officer recommends that the SOC hold a debrief discussion on the feedback provided by the community so far.
Chief Executive Officer further recommends that the SOC direct staff to organize one more community meeting to be held in late January 2024, and the venue to be generally in the southern section of the City.
STAFF REPORT
5.
Measure BP Sales Tax Financial Update
STAFF REPORT
6.
Holiday Recess for SOC Meetings CEO recommends that the SOC cancel its meeting of Tuesday January 9, 2024, in recognition of the fact that Staff may be on vacation during the Holiday recess period.
7.
Stakeholders Oversight Committee (SOC) Meeting Minutes It is recommended that the Committee approve the Regular Measure BP Stakeholders Oversight Meetings held on September 12, 2023 and October 10, 2023.
